title: Affine modulation preserves sign values
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\mathbb F_2^n\\to\\mathbb R$ satisfy $|f(x)|=1$ for every $x$, let $\\sigma\\in\\{-1,1\\}$, and let $a\\in\\mathbb F_2^n$. Then the function $x\\mapsto\\sigma(-1)^{\\sum_i a_i x_i}f(x)$ also has absolute value $1$ at every input.
hypotheses_covered: $f:\\mathbb F_2^n\\to\\mathbb R$ has absolute value $1$ at every input
